% A document with titletoc's partial table of contents, beside the .ptc
% of an earlier build and the .aux of a later build that did not use
% titletoc, so the .aux does not name the .ptc. The .ptc holds titletoc's
% \ttl@starttoc and an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this
% document does not define. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titletoc}
\begin{document}
\section{First}
\startcontents
\printcontents{}{1}{}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{New subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\end{document}
